summary: Start each subagent lease when its claim is issued, after work attribution and preceding API requests

replay.detail: Existing subagent claims replay unchanged; only new appearance and renewal expiry timestamps change.

schema.detail: No database schema or stored format change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or claim validation rules change.

compatibility.detail: Uses the existing lease expiry field and duration with existing clients and daemons.

recovery.detail: Revert the timestamp calculation to restore previous behavior; existing claims need no repair.
